title: Mark Felt pushes to investigate the Mexico bank account

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer and researcher, told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2024 about something that happened at the FBI in 1972. He says Mark Felt, a senior FBI official, insisted on going to Mexico City the next morning to look into a bank account, a move that put him at odds with his boss, the FBI's acting director Pat Gray. If true, it shows a top FBI man pushing to follow money that others wanted left alone.
